hypothesis_summary.name: Residual Momentum Diversifier (Core-Level Alpha Target)
hypothesis_summary.mechanism: 각 종목 t월: M04_Mom_12_1 (past 12M return skipping last 1M)을 매월 cross-section OLS로 beta(24M rolling CAPM) + log(Size) + R12_IdioVol 3-factor 잔차화. 잔차를 Z_Score_Aligned. Top 20 EW. Barroso-Santa-Clara 2015 RFS 'Risk-Managed Momentum' framework 준수. Momentum의 beta-exposure와 size-exposure 제거 → 'clean residual momentum' signal.
hypothesis_summary.why_now: Governor v1.1 결론 — Scenario C/D (H_1676+H_1682 admit) SR 1.65~1.78, **Core 수준 독립 alpha 1건 추가가 SR 2.0 도달 필수조건**. Residual momentum family는 Carhart 1997 JF foundational anomaly. 한국 Factor DB M04_Mom_12_1 존재하나 잔차화 standalone 가설 없음. Barroso framework (L-122 factor risk management)의 momentum 적용 전례는 국내 미구축.
hypothesis_summary.expected_role_reason: H_1676 consensus(diversifier), H_1682 distress+risk(defense)와 orthogonal family. Momentum family 자체는 기존 STR_1631/STR_1656/STR_1679v2와 구분 (consensus/ML/Q07-D29 중심). 잔차화로 beta+size exposure 제거 → portfolio rho < 0.25 설계 가능. **Governor 목표**: SR >= 1.0 standalone + rho < 0.25 vs existing PG2.
hypothesis_summary.distinctive_from_H_1687: H_1687은 Q25 distress × M04 momentum interaction (composite). H_1688은 M04 momentum 자체의 beta+size+idiovol 잔차화. Mechanism 완전 상이 — H_1687은 double-factor composite, H_1688은 single-factor residualization.

academic_foundation.primary_reference: Carhart, Mark M., 1997, 'On Persistence in Mutual Fund Performance', Journal of Finance 52, 57-82.
academic_foundation.core_reference: Part A 참조번호 TBD + Carhart 1997 JF (UMD momentum factor foundational) + Barroso-Santa-Clara 2015 JFE (residualized momentum risk management)
secondary_references: Jegadeesh, Narasimhan and Sheridan Titman, 1993, 'Returns to Buying Winners and Selling Losers', Journal of Finance 48, 65-91. (classic momentum)
Barroso, Pedro and Pedro Santa-Clara, 2015, 'Momentum Has Its Moments', Journal of Financial Economics 116, 111-120. (residualized + risk-managed momentum)
Blitz, David, Joop Huij, and Martin Martens, 2011, 'Residual Momentum', Journal of Empirical Finance 18, 506-521. (beta/size/BM 잔차화 momentum, direct primary reference)

Grundy, Bruce D. and J. Spencer Martin, 2001, 'Understanding the Nature of the Risks and the Source of the Rewards to Momentum Investing', Review of Financial Studies 14, 29-78. (momentum이 implicit factor bets)
이진철·김동철 (2015), '한국주식시장의 잔차 모멘텀', 한국재무학회지 28, 211-249. (한국 residual momentum 직접 실증)
Kim, Byoung-Kyu and Steve Park, 2019, 'Robust Momentum Strategies in Korean Stock Markets', Asia-Pacific Journal of Financial Studies. (한국 risk-managed momentum)
academic_foundation.mechanism_academic: Blitz-Huij-Martens 2011: raw momentum은 beta/size/BM에 대한 implicit bet을 내포. 잔차 momentum은 이러한 bet 제거 후 pure 'time-series strength' 포착. 결과: (1) Sharpe 0.5 → 1.0+ 개선, (2) momentum crash 완화, (3) 타 strategy와 low correlation. Barroso 2015: dynamic scaling + residualization으로 SR 2배. 한국 이진철 2015: 한국에서도 잔차 momentum 유효 (monthly t-stat 3+).
academic_foundation.korean_specific: 한국 momentum anomaly 기존 실증: 1~3M reversal, 6~12M momentum, 48M reversal 패턴. 단 raw momentum은 beta/size 편향 큼 (대형주 momentum strong). 잔차화 후에도 alpha 유효 (이진철 2015, Kim-Park 2019). Factor DB M04_Mom_12_1 + M01_CAPM_Beta + S01_Size + R12_IdioVol 모두 기구축.

core_reference: Carhart 1997 JF 'On Persistence in Mutual Fund Performance' + Blitz-Huij-Martens 2011 JEF 'Residual Momentum' + Barroso-Santa-Clara 2015 JFE 'Momentum Has Its Moments' + 이진철·김동철 2015 한국재무학회지 '한국주식시장의 잔차 모멘텀' (Part A에 추가 요청 예정)
